claim: Runs stay in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context; complete a demo drill; intercept every request and assert same-origin only

claim: Export the run record when the check passes.
sandbox: fresh demo; pass one drill; download JSON and assert seed, pass state, and seven trace points

claim: The import checks exported JSON and previews the record count before saving.
sandbox: fresh demo; reject malformed JSON; preview one valid record before confirmation; import it; reject the same record as a duplicate

claim: Imported records are saved only in the active workbench.
where: workbench import status, demo documentation, README
sandbox: fresh demo with a real-workbench sentinel, then a fresh real workbench with a demo sentinel; import one record in each mode and assert only that mode's storage changes

claim: Imported run records can be replayed.
sandbox: fresh demo; import a known passing tensor-shape record; replay it and assert the saved source still passes

claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved.
where: demo banner, privacy page, README Try the sample, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh demo with a real-workbench sentinel; create a run and leave through Home, Privacy, browser Back, and Open your real workbench in separate flows; after every exit assert sessionStorage and legacy localStorage demo keys are absent, the real key is unchanged, and re-entering demo is empty; also assert Reset demo clears the same isolated key

claim: Try it with sample data opens a tensor-shape drill with fixed sample inputs.
where: landing primary action and note, README Try the sample
sandbox: fresh landing with a real-workbench sentinel; click the primary action and, before an answer check, assert /demo, the persistent banner and Reset demo control, tensor-shape fixed inputs, an editable starter, no demo run record, and an untouched real sentinel; then open /?demo=1 directly and assert the same sample, reset behavior, and isolation

claim: The project uses no runtime third-party scripts, remote fonts, or analytics.
sandbox: fresh landing and demo navigation; record all requests and assert every resource, including scripts, styles, and fonts, is same-origin

claim: The build creates dist/index.html and the static deployment assets.
sandbox: clean test run builds first; assert dist/index.html, built JavaScript, service worker, 404 page, and deployment config exist

claim: The built config supports direct links, the 404 page, caching, and browser security headers.
sandbox: inspect dist/staticwebapp.config.json; assert direct-route rewrites, 404 override, immutable asset rule, CSP and nosniff; request a direct route and missing route

claim: After your first visit, drills and saved run records are available offline.
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit landing and demo; save a passing record; set offline; reload demo; assert the saved seed, record, and Replay remain available with no network egress

claim: All 30 drills are open.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert the drill catalog contains exactly 30 drill controls

claim: Each of the 30 drills checks its stated operation against fixed drill data.
sandbox: fresh demo; compare every visible task with an independently declared specification, submit that specification's intended operation and assert pass, then submit its independently declared shortcut and assert rejection

claim: The browser checks one answer line against each drill's fixed inputs.
sandbox: fresh demo; submit comment-only invalid source and observe Not yet; submit tuple(x.size()) against the fixed shape fixture and observe Passed

claim: The browser check rejects changed drill inputs and incomplete expressions.
sandbox: fresh demo; change the 8×3 fixture to 1×1 with x.shape, then submit bare torch.randperm; both must show Not yet

claim: The browser reruns the same seven results from the same inputs.
sandbox: fresh demo; pass the first drill twice; export records and assert both seven-point traces are identical

claim: The browser check does not execute arbitrary Python or PyTorch.
sandbox: fresh demo; submit a Python raise statement plus the required operation; assert it is rejected and the browser raises no execution error

claim: Open your real workbench opens a separate real workbench.
sandbox: fresh demo; select Open your real workbench; pass one drill; assert the real key is written and the demo key is untouched

claim: Free. All 30 drills are open.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert all 30 drill controls are enabled and no checkout, subscription, or payment-required state is present

claim: No chat required.
sandbox: fresh demo; complete a drill without chat or account controls and assert every request is a same-origin GET

claim: It does not host models, rank people, or give generated solutions.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert there are no hosting, upload, ranking, or solution-generation controls and a shortcut receives feedback without revealing an answer

claim: It does not send your code, run records, or identity to a server.
sandbox: fresh browser context; read Privacy and Terms; enter a unique code marker, check it, export and import records; inspect every request URL, method, header, and body for the marker or identity data; assert no account or identity control exists

claim: Complete five distinct drills for one practice set.
where: demo and real workbench progress counter
sandbox: fresh demo with a real-workbench sentinel; complete five distinct drills, repeat one, reload, and reset; assert 0/5 through 5/5, deduplication, persistence, reset, and storage isolation
